alternatives_rejected.why: Inbound errors only rose from 0.0 to 0.0008 while caller-observed latency rose 14x (E2); loss would produce more errors and retries than a pure, uniform latency shift.
Its latency rise (990.5%, E1) is smaller than currencyservice's (1353.7% p50, 1569.5% p90, E1/E3), consistent with checkoutservice inheriting latency from its currencyservice calls.
Frontend latency and external errors (E1) line up with the downstream currencyservice slowdown seen by callers (E2); no frontend-specific evidence points at a local fault.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect the currencyservice pod's network (e.g., tc/netem qdisc rules on its interface) and remove any injected delay; if none is found, restart or reschedule the currencyservice pod and confirm that caller-observed p50 latency returns to about 5ms.
